Show less Read more Like 1 Dislike Reply @pateva2003 2 weeks ago (edited) Living in H-Town and drawing on typical Niños, here's what a Super or even a decent one might mean for the Southern US. 1.Our best shot for Hurricane activity may be homegrown, a TUTT festering in a warm Gulf or a MCS moving offshore and spinning up a cane.Alicia 1983 or Barry 2019 for example. 2. A rainy summer or a Murderous drought, depending where High pressure sets up. 3.An active second severe weather season in the fall. Possibly a nasty Dixie alley season as well. I'm just shooting my shot here, if anybody in the meteorological community cares to weigh in and correct me ,I humbly await.
